_what: Human judgement over the automatic Commons pick (brief §18, §49).
_how: A value is the exact Commons title to use for that institution; `null` means no file in its
category is acceptable and the institution keeps the typeset identity instead.
Every entry below was made by looking at a contact sheet of the automatic picks. The automatic
rule — widest attribution-free file, else widest credited one — is good at size and blind to
subject: it chose a stage performance for Pusan National, a 1900s map for Dong-A, a wordmark for
Korea National University of Education, a fire drill for Pai Chai, and portraits of individual
people for KAIST, DGIST and Daejeon. Filename heuristics cannot catch those. A person can, and
the result is written down here so the next run is reproducible rather than re-judged.
